hypothesis: LingBot's 0.5 clean-video corruption probability reduces the deployment-proxy masked val40 action loss while retaining the quantile arm's clean val40 improvement.
single_variable: With probability 0.5 per sample, corrupt every clean-video latent frame with an independently sampled high-noise timestep. Quantile action normalization, one action timestep per window, initialization, seed, first 800 windows, model and optimizer remain fixed.
parent_baseline: E24 quantile s100 clean val40 video/action 0.166345/1.295573 from initialization 0.170026/1.304397. The matched quantile initialization and E24 masked val40 must be measured before promotion.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.local: four streams share H3 blocks; tail-2 trainable
architecture.rationale: H3 port is unchanged across arms.

data.rationale: Condition-corruption RNG is independently seeded and does not perturb base video/action noise draws.

objective.upstream_code: latent _add_noise called with noisy_cond_prob=0.5 and cond timestep in [0.5,1.0]
objective.local: probability0.5; one high-noise shifted timestep per H3 latent frame; clean target unchanged
objective.rationale: H3 uses its native video shift12 rather than Wan's shift5; the corruption semantics and probability are preserved.

optimization.rationale: Exposure-bias signal is tested before scale.

evaluation.local: clean val40 plus masked-clean-future val40; causal sample40 only after both pass
evaluation.rationale: The mechanism specifically targets robustness to missing/imperfect clean future context.

evidence: same E24 windows and independent corruption RNG
E24 checkpoint contract plus stored corruption probability
E24 clean val40; masked baseline measured before decision
official upstream train path directly uses probability0.5

decision.rationale: Train s100, then evaluate clean val40 and masked-clean-future val40 for initialization, E24 and this arm. Run causal sample40 only if clean action remains at least 0.5% better than initialization and masked action improves at least 0.5% over E24 while masked video does not regress more than 2%. Otherwise stop without rollout.
